source_caption:
During filming of Batman v Superman: Dawn of Justice, Ben Affleck asked the studio if he could keep the Batsuit after production. The costume was so expensive—reportedly costing over $100,000—that the studio jokingly told him he could take it home only if he paid for it.

Batman v Superman: Dawn of Justice (2016), directed by Zack Snyder, starring Ben Affleck, Henry Cavill, Gal Gadot. A dark and operatic clash of icons where two legendary heroes confront fear, power, and responsibility, setting the stage for a larger mythic battle within the DC universe.

source_details.synopsis: Batman v Superman: Dawn of Justice is a 2016 American superhero film based on the DC Comics characters Batman and Superman. Directed by Zack Snyder and written by Chris Terrio and David S. Goyer, it is a follow-up to Man of Steel (2013) and the second film in the DC Extended Universe (DCEU). The film stars Ben Affleck as Batman and Henry Cavill as Superman, alongside a cast including Amy Adams, Jesse Eisenberg, Diane Lane, Laurence Fishburne, Jeremy Irons, Holly Hunter, and Gal Gadot. Batman v Superman: Dawn of Justice is the first live-action film to feature Batman and Superman together, as well as the first live-action cinematic portrayal of Wonder Woman.
